_what: PUBLIC-SAFE film + price + glass-compatibility data for the ikonic303.com film page
_authority: Rulings transcribed from Edge Film Technologies 'Architectural Film to Glass Chart'. The PDF wins on conflict. Prices from rail R-2026-08-28-TINT.
_rule: RULING IS PER EXACT FILM (VLT). Price is per group. Never collapse a group into one ruling.

restrictions.edge_words: Single pane glass should be less than 100 square feet
Dual pane glass should be less than 40 square feet
Clear glass should be less than 3/8 inch thick
Architecturally odd shaped windows more than 25 square feet void the warranty
Uneven shading from the exterior will void warranty

unknown_glass: Restriction 2 is written for DUAL pane. ikonic applies the same 40 sq ft cap to TRIPLE pane as a conservative house rule — this is OURS, not Edge's wording.
Wired glass has no column on this chart -> UNKNOWN -> no online price, on-site assessment.
Tinted DUAL/TRIPLE pane has no column on this chart -> UNKNOWN -> no online price, on-site assessment.
Existing crack / chip / fogging / failed IGU seal / glass already filmed -> NO-GO regardless of dot.
'X Series 7mil Clear' does NOT appear on this chart. No ruling exists. Never quote it.
excluded_from_page: X Series 7mil Clear — no film-to-glass ruling exists. Never quote, never list.
